The combination of shrinking assets, reduced shareholder equity, a significant net loss, decreasing profitability margins, and reduced EPS creates a strongly negative picture. While revenue has grown, the increased costs and overall financial decline outweigh the positive impact. The company needs to address the drivers of the losses immediately.  The slight improvements in revenue are not enough to offset the larger negative factors.
